items.title: Repeated reconciliation preserves content after an unmatched start marker.
items.requirement: Unmatched markers must produce a non-destructive diagnostic. Reconciliation must preserve unrelated content and be idempotent.
items.evidence: reconcileGitignore() stops its end-marker search at the next start marker. The updated test checks the second reconciliation.

items.title: Obsolete-rule removal now uses exact line matching.
items.requirement: Remove only exact obsolete RunWield lines. Keep unrelated custom patterns byte-equivalent.
items.evidence: isObsoleteRunWieldLine() no longer trims or normalizes the line. Tests preserve leading-space and rooted custom patterns.

items.title: Resumed local merges now check incoming history before continuing.
items.requirement: Saved-attempt and repair paths must reject runtime hazards before advancing the target.
items.evidence: worktree.js checks MERGE_HEAD history before merge --continue in both mergeExecutionWorktreeIntoCurrentCheckout() and resolvePlanMergeConflicts(). Both paths also check HEAD and the index.

items.title: Saved publication copies now check HEAD and the index before automatic merges.
items.requirement: Check incoming history and HEAD/index safety before automatic merges and commits.
items.evidence: isolated-publication.ts: the requestedRootExists branch calls assertNoTrackedOrIndexedRuntimePaths(publicationRoot) before target synchronization or execution merges.

items.title: The reported runtime-refusal paths now preserve repair and publication checkouts.
items.requirement: Refusal must preserve execution and repair checkouts and permit retry after authorized cleanup.
items.evidence: publishRepairedMergeWorktree() checks history outside the cleanup catch. Isolated publication sets preserveForRecovery before final metadata and history checks.

items.title: Missing-remote publication now checks the full candidate history.
items.requirement: Inspect every commit newly reachable from the intended publication target.
items.evidence: Both remote publication paths use a null publicationHistoryBase when the remote target is absent. The history helper then runs rev-list without --not.

items.title: The reported runtime refusals now reach the cleanup pause.
items.requirement: Runtime refusal must report blocking paths through the recoverable cleanup and retry flow.
items.evidence: validation-publication.ts catches and normalizes dispatchMergeRepair() errors. Both target-sync catches in isolated-publication.ts preserve the runtime failure kind and blockingPaths. publishRepairedMergeWorktree() also preserves these fields.

items.title: Secret runtime errors now include exposure and rotation warnings.
items.requirement: A tracked secret must also carry the existing exposure and capability-rotation warning.
items.evidence: RunWieldRuntimeGitSafetyError checks current and legacy collaboration-secret paths, including temporary suffixes, and adds the exposure and capability-rotation warning.

items.title: The reported dirty-path reads now preserve NUL-delimited filenames.
items.requirement: Use NUL-delimited path output without trimming filenames, and preserve exact paths in dirty-path protection.
items.evidence: publishToLocalTarget() uses runGitRaw(). Dirty-overlap checks use -z branch diffs, parseNulPaths(), and gitStatusPaths(); worktree.js runGit() preserves raw stdout.

items.title: Merged side-branch and unsafe completed-repair test cases remain missing.
items.requirement: Step 7 requires real Git tests for incoming side-branch history and unsafe saved or completed repairs, including runtime data committed and later deleted.
items.evidence: The repair adds preparation refusal, saved-checkout HEAD refusal, index-entry preservation, and partially staged content preservation. However, worktree-runtime-state-isolation.test.js and isolated-publication.test.ts still lack a candidate with runtime history from a merged side branch. validation-merge-repair.test.ts tests an unfinished merge with MERGE_HEAD, not an unsafe completed repair. The saved-publication test retains runtime data in HEAD; it does not test saved or completed repair history where runtime data was later deleted.
